domain: Moral Philosophy / Historical Ethics / Commitment Systems
topic_summary: Analysis of Spartan infant exposure (apothetis) as a historical instantiation of a personhood-boundary kernel that admitted a hillside-exposure reading no longer accessible from modern moral frameworks. Tests whether moral possibility-space contraction represents reading-dropout (the reading became structurally unavailable) or window-shift (the reading persists but observers cannot reach it).

key_entities: Spartan gerousia (council of elders; adjudicators of infant fitness)
Apothetis (hillside exposure practice; operational mechanism of personhood-boundary enforcement)
Modern human rights framework (post-1948 universal personhood commitment)
Plutarch (primary source; Life of Lycurgus describes exposure practice)
Taygetus hillside (physical site of exposure; material substrate of the practice)
key_tensions: State eugenic authority vs parental autonomy (gerousia inspection vs family decision rights)
Collective fitness maximization vs individual infant moral status (polis survival vs infant life)
Historical moral pluralism vs modern universalism (exposure as legitimate reading vs categorical impermissibility)

omegas.description: Plutarch wrote 500+ years after Lycurgus. Is the exposure practice historical fact or ideological projection? If projection, the 'reading' may never have been instantiated.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) + F34 epistemic trespass concern

omegas.description: Are there intermediate readings between exposure and universal personhood (e.g., Christian baptism-contingent personhood, Enlightenment rationality-contingent personhood) that would demonstrate gradual path rather than discontinuous jump?
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) + path_naturalization_mechanism deferral

omegas.description: Does the exposure reading require actual exposure practice, or can it persist as coherent moral framework without implementation? Distinction between normative commitment and enforcement mechanism.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 1 (Operational Medium) — analysis operates in normative-framework medium but kernel may be practice-dependent

omegas.description: Did Spartan framework assign different personhood boundaries to Spartan infants vs helot infants? If so, exposure reading may be ethnicity-contingent rather than fitness-contingent.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 3 (Beneficiary Scan) — helots absent from extraction despite being majority population

fracture_scan.notes: F34 detected: Model has limited training on ancient Spartan social practices beyond Plutarch's account. Research context indicates user awareness of this limitation.

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: The personhood-boundary kernel: the threshold at which a human organism acquires moral status requiring protection from state-sanctioned killing
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: In exposure reading: gerousia (council of elders) adjudicates fitness; authority grounded in polis survival mandate. In universal reading: no adjudication permitted; authority grounded in inherent human dignity (post-Enlightenment natural rights)
commitment_system_recognition.candidate_pattern: Interpretive Petrification (exposure reading) vs Founding Ambiguity Collapse (universal reading locked via UDHR)

readings.commitment: Moral status contingent on demonstrated fitness; state authority to adjudicate personhood at birth
readings.authority_grounding: Polis survival mandate; gerousia as fitness adjudicators; collective utility maximization
readings.expected_structural_delta: Infants enter victim set only after passing inspection; state holds legitimate authority to expose; high ε from beneficiary (military state) extracting from victim (unfit infants)

readings.commitment: Moral status begins at birth regardless of fitness; state categorically prohibited from adjudicating personhood
readings.authority_grounding: Enlightenment autonomy commitment; Kantian categorical imperative; UDHR Article 3 (right to life)
readings.expected_structural_delta: All infants enter victim set at birth; state exposure categorically impermissible; high ε from rights-bearing infants constraining state eugenic programs

axiom_contradictions.basis: Exposure reading holds that personhood is contingent (fitness-dependent) and state-adjudicated; universal reading holds that personhood is inherent (birth-dependent) and non-adjudicable. No single coherent framework can hold both 'personhood is contingent on X' and 'personhood is categorically non-contingent' simultaneously.
